title: Public Code and Inspectable Engineering Signal
summary: Public-safe index of code and repository surfaces a visitor can inspect without relying on private systems, internal project names, confidential metrics, screenshots, logs, or employer architecture.

reviewRubric.question: Does the public repository show an operational reasoning loop rather than a generic chatbot wrapper?
reviewRubric.lookFor: README/spec language around fetch, classify, playbook, evidence gathering, deterministic scoring, RCA output, and replayable receipts.
reviewRubric.supports: Connects the public-code signal to Operational Intelligence, Agentic SRE, evidence-driven investigation, and evaluation gates.
reviewRubric.doNotInfer: Do not infer production adoption, customer use, private deployment topology, incident volume, or employer implementation.

reviewRubric.question: Does the repository expose bounded execution and governance concerns?
reviewRubric.lookFor: Policy gate, execution budgets, circuit breakers, fixed playbooks, fallback behavior, optional model use, and scope limits.
reviewRubric.supports: Shows the same operating taste emphasized on seri.ai: deterministic first, bounded, auditable, and public-safe.
reviewRubric.doNotInfer: Do not assume the public implementation is the same as any private or employer system.

reviewRubric.question: Does the repository include evaluation and replay surfaces that another engineer can inspect?
reviewRubric.lookFor: Eval scenarios, answer fixtures, investigation skills, playbooks, memory folders, receipt-shaped artifacts, and failure-mode docs.
reviewRubric.supports: Makes public code part of the evidence graph rather than a decorative GitHub link.
reviewRubric.doNotInfer: Do not treat file counts, repository presence, or fixtures as proof of live model quality or production reliability.

reviewRubric.question: Can the public work be connected back to Ravikanth's career arc?
reviewRubric.lookFor: Links between incident investigation, observability, topology, operational memory, tool governance, AI evaluation, and reliability.
reviewRubric.supports: Connects enterprise infrastructure background to current AI-native operations work without exposing protected details.
reviewRubric.doNotInfer: Do not use public code to claim private metrics, confidential integrations, unpublished architecture, or customer outcomes.

observedPublicStructure: Public README and agent specification describe an incident investigation pipeline, deterministic playbooks, policy gates, memory, receipts, observability, and optional model-assisted refinement.
Local public checkout exposes five agent notes, ten investigation skills, ten playbook configs, five eval scenario folders, and receipt/wiki-style artifacts.
Public-safe interpretation: architectural signal about operational agents, not proof of private deployment, production adoption, or live incident outcomes.
